{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Read the data
df = pd.read_csv('data/trial.csv')

# Check for duplicates in patient_id
duplicate_patients = df['patient_id'].duplicated(keep=False)
print(f"Number of rows with duplicate patient_id: {duplicate_patients.sum()}")

# Check how many unique patients there are
df_unique_patients = df.drop_duplicates(subset='patient_id', keep='last')
print(f"Number of unique patients after deduplication: {len(df_unique_patients)}")

# Verify that we're keeping the highest sample_seq for each patient
sample_seq_check = df.groupby('patient_id')['sample_seq'].max().reset_index()
print(f"Max sample_seq per patient: {sample_seq_check['sample_seq'].describe()}")

# Check if any patient_id appears more than once after deduplication
after_dedup = df.drop_duplicates(subset='patient_id', keep='last')
print(f"Unique patient_id count after dedup: {after_dedup['patient_id'].nunique()}")"}
